'''Uneme Clan''' (采女氏) refers to an ancient Japanese clan that bore the name "Uneme" and served as administrators overseeing court attendants ([[Uneme]]). Initially bearing the title '''Uneme no Omī''', the clan later assumed the title '''Uneme no Asomi'''. The clan was a [[Tomonomiyatsuko|Tomobe]] responsible for overseeing {{ill|Uneme|ja|采女|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Uneme|qq=}}.

== Overview ==
The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|qid=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' records the clan as "Right Capital Divine Lineage, Heavenly Deities, Uneme no Asomi, related to the Ishikami no Asomi. They are descendants of [[Nigihayahi]], with [[Ōminakuchi no Sukune no Mikoto]] as their ancestor." More precisely, Nigihayahi's sixth-generation descendant was {{ill|Oomizuguchi no Sukune|ja|大水口宿禰命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōmizuguchi no Sukune|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 大水口宿禰|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11436785}}. Originally titled with the ''Omī'' Rank, the clan was elevated to ''Asomi'' in the 13th year of Emperor {{ill|Emperor Tenmu|ja|Emperor Tenmu|2=ja|3=天武天皇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenmu|13=User:Immanuelle/Emperor Tenmu|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q335181}} (684 CE) with the {{ill|Eight Kabane system|ja|八色の姓|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Colors of Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Kabane system|qq=}} reforms.

During the {{ill|Asuka period|en|Asuka period|qid=Q210688|lt=Asuka period}}, notable members included {{ill|Q58139695|ja|采女摩礼志|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Uneme Mareishi|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q58139695}}, who, alongside {{ill|Nakatomi no Mikeko|ja|中臣御食子|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nakatomi no Mikeko|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11366911}} and {{ill|Q58139701|ja|高向宇摩|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takamukai no Uma|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q58139701}}, supported the succession of {{ill|Emperor Jomei|en|Emperor Jomei|qid=Q329761|lt=Emperor Jomei}} after {{ill|Empress Suiko|en|Empress Suiko|qid=Q298057|lt=Empress Suiko}}'s death.

Another prominent figure was {{ill|Uneme no Tsukura|ja|采女竹羅|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Uneme Takera|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q57888145}}, a court official during the same period. In the 10th year of Emperor Tenmu's reign, Takera held the Rank of ''{{ill|Shōkōnige|ja|小錦下|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōninkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11464364}}'' and served as the Envoy to Silla. In the 13th year, he was dispatched with Prince {{ill|Yoshi Tsutomuo|ja|三野王|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mino|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 美努王|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11608781}} to explore sites in {{ill|Shinano Province|en|Shinano Province|qid=Q289250|lt=Shinano Province}} for the construction of a new capital. Upon the establishment of the {{ill|Eight Kabane system|ja|八色の姓|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Colors of Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Kabane system|qq=}}, he was granted the ''Asomi'' title. Takera is believed to have died around the 3rd year of {{ill|Empress Jitō|en|Empress Jitō|qid=Q232026|lt=Empress Jitō}}'s reign. An epitaph erected on December 25 of that year referred to him as "Takera of Uneme, Minister of the Great Court at Asuka Kiyohara, Senior Deputy of the {{ill|benkan|ja|大弁官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbenkan|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q3270768}}." His name also appears as ''Chikura'' or ''Takeyoshi.''

Later, {{ill|Q17217390|ja|采女枚夫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Uneme Hikafu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q17217390}} achieved the Rank of ''Shōgoige'' (Senior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade).
